entries.scene: Vertical chest-up selfie inside a gray car in daylight, long hair over the shoulder on screen-left, black narrow-strap top and small stud earrings; window and pillar on screen-left, rear seat and headrest behind. The opening is a close view with eyelids closed mid-blink and relaxed closed lips.
entries.openingFrameRisk: closed eyelids at t=0; preserve original blink, verify identity separately

beats.action: Open the eyes from the initial blink and look calmly toward the lens; keep the lips closed.
Let the handheld view move backward and tilt slightly upward, revealing more of the torso and car roof; the head becomes smaller and lower in the frame.

Briefly glance upward toward screen-right, blink and return toward the lens. A pale ringed hand briefly passes across the bottom foreground near the end of this interval, then drops out; it never rises to the mouth.
Hold the settled chest-up framing and a restrained closed-lip expression, then start shifting the eyes upward toward screen-right.
Maintain the upward screen-right glance and gently purse the lips into a small pout, with brief blinks and very little head movement.
Relax the pout, bring the eyes back toward the lens and finish in the same settled car composition.

entries.scene: Vertical selfie seated on a beige sofa against a cream wall, cabinet and dark shelving edge on screen-right. Black long-sleeve off-shoulder top over visible white straps, small earrings and fine necklace. One sleeve-covered forearm crosses the chest; the pale-nailed hand rests on the opposite shoulder at screen-right. The very first picture is slightly motion-soft.
entries.openingFrameRisk: initial motion softness and caption over face; prepare original t=0 composition, not a later literal pose

beats.action: Let the initial handheld wobble settle while looking at the lens. Keep the sleeve-covered forearm across the chest and its hand resting on the opposite shoulder at screen-right.
Tilt the head slightly toward screen-right and press the lips into a skeptical pout as the view drifts a little closer and off-center.
Keep the pout and direct gaze. Slide the fingertips a little upward along the shoulder toward the side of the neck, preserving contact and the visible white strap.
Briefly lower the eyelids and shift the hand back flatter across the shoulder while the framing eases wider.
Turn the face and eyes toward screen-left and hold that restrained sideways look with closed lips, hand still on the shoulder.
Return toward the camera and hold the composed closed-mouth expression through the final picture, preserving the crossed forearm and shoulder contact.

entries.scene: Vertical chest-up selfie in a pale doorway, a broad pale door edge on screen-left, white jamb and black hinge on screen-right, warm light behind. Dark oversized printed T-shirt, pendant necklace and small earrings, high tied-back ponytail. Head tipped slightly toward screen-left, direct gaze and a small closed-lip smile.
entries.openingFrameRisk: clear face; door edge must remain in ending

beats.action: Hold a small closed-lip smile toward the lens with the head tipped toward screen-left and shoulders relaxed.
Blink, turn the eyes toward screen-left and gently purse the lips. Keep the doorway edge in the foreground and hands outside the crop.
Let the handheld viewpoint drift slightly closer and sideways as the face angles down toward screen-left, keeping the lips pursed; do not turn this continuous movement into a cut.
Lift the eyes upward toward screen-left, hold the questioning glance and keep the mouth closed.
Return the gaze toward the lens, release the pout into a small pressed-lip smile and let the head straighten.

Tip the head back toward the pale door edge on screen-left as the handheld view shifts. Finish with the edge partly cropping the screen-left side of the head and a small closed-mouth smile toward the lens.

entries.scene: Vertical low-light car selfie with the face centered below a large dark roof area, dark seat behind and a pale window on screen-right. Long dark hair over dark clothing and a light outer layer at the shoulder. Bent arm remains behind the head on screen-left, pale watchband visible. The dense original caption obscures the mouth area; underlying mouth details are not directly verified.
entries.openingFrameRisk: low exposure and caption conceal lower face; mouth motion remains unknown

beats.action: Hold the reclined car pose with one bent arm behind the head on screen-left. Look toward the lens with subtle eyelid and eyebrow movement; retain the very dim exposure.
Make small head and gaze adjustments with a natural blink while keeping the arm behind the head and the window and roof stable.
Let the head tip a little toward screen-left and the eyelids lower briefly, then reopen toward the lens. Keep the expression restrained; do not add exaggerated mouth acting.
Ease the head back toward upright with small handheld bob and a steady camera-facing gaze.
Allow a small final downward dip of the head and viewpoint, ending in the same dark car with the arm still behind the head. Do not introduce a cut, a new light source or a hand-to-mouth gesture.

entries.scene: Vertical daylight selfie in a car, chest-up with a pale yellow-green sleeveless knitted button-front top, small hoop and stud earrings, fine necklace and diagonal dark seatbelt from screen-right shoulder toward screen-left waist. Dark seat, roof and side window behind. Face is angled slightly toward screen-left while the eyes look toward the lens; lips gently pressed.
entries.openingFrameRisk: clear opening; preserve seatbelt and passing exterior

beats.action: Keep the seated pose and direct lens gaze with lightly pressed lips; the seatbelt stays taut diagonally across the torso.
Tilt the head gently toward screen-left and lift the eyes upward in the same direction, maintaining a quiet questioning expression.

Let the handheld camera move gradually closer from chest-up toward a face-dominant selfie while holding the upward screen-left gaze. Preserve the car interior and continuous passing scenery outside the side window.
Hold the closer framing with a restrained closed-lip half-smile and a brief blink; keep the head slightly tilted.
Return the eyes nearer the lens while retaining the small smile. Preserve the slight camera bob and closer final crop, seatbelt and daylight through the end.

entries.scene: Vertical close selfie against a cream wall and white panel seam on screen-right, light gray open knitted cardigan over white top, pendant necklace, long hair and small white earbud. Pale manicured ringed fingers rest diagonally across the forehead from screen-right. Eyes face the lens with slightly knitted brows and pressed lips.
entries.openingFrameRisk: forehead hand leaves most face visible; retain opening contact

beats.action: Hold the pale-nailed fingers diagonally against the forehead from screen-right and look toward the lens with pressed lips and mildly knitted brows.
Slide the fingertips outward toward the temple and lift the hand completely away off screen-right while blinking and turning the eyes toward screen-right.
Hold the screen-right gaze with the hand outside the frame, lips firmly closed and expression quietly resigned.
Blink and turn back toward the lens, beginning a small head tilt toward screen-left.
Hold the tipped-head, pressed-lip half-smile toward the lens as the handheld view moves slightly closer. Keep the earbud, cardigan and necklace continuous.
Make a slow blink with the head still tipped, reopen the eyes and ease back into the wider ending view with the same restrained closed-mouth look. The hand stays lowered.
